TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with “Sekhon Indian Air Force Marathon 2025” being organised by the Indian Air Force on 02nd November 2025 (Sunday), over 10,000 participants are expected. The Marathon will be flagged off from Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi at 05:30 AM and will conclude by 11:00 AM. Traffic diversions/restrictions will be in place on the following routes and adjoining stretches.

📍Routes:
•Half Marathon (05:30 AM) – JLN Stadium → Lodhi Road → Mathura Road → Subramaniam Bharti Marg → Kartavya Path → Janpath → back to JLN Stadium
•Open 10 KM (06:30 AM)
JLN Stadium → Lodhi Road → Mathura Road → Lodhi Road → Bhisma Pitamah Marg → back to Stadium
•Open 5 KM (07:30 AM)
JLN Stadium → Lodhi Road → BP Marg → back to Stadium

📍Traffic Regulation (04:45 AM – 10:00 AM):
Traffic will be regulated on the above routes for participant safety. Uninterrupted movement of emergency vehicles will be facilitated.
📍Suggested Routes:
•NORTH-SOUTH
Ring Road – Ashram Chowk – Sarai Kale Khan – ISBT Kashmere Gate
•EAST-WEST
DND Flyover – AIIMS – Dhaula Kuan – Naraina – ITO – Connaught Place
📍Avoid affected stretches and plan journeys accordingly.
📍Use public transport to minimize congestion.
📍 Plan travel to ISBTs, Railway Stations & Airports in advance.
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
